lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance white spots are distributed in roughly vertical columns across the lateral flank posterior to the gills, with higher spatial frequency in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a distinct grid-like matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct light-to-dark vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small white spots, though clarity is reduced by surface water refraction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several dark, curved linear marks resembling healed abrasions are visible on the mid-lateral flank just posterior to the gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: A large aggregation of remoras is present on the ventral side and near the pectoral fin.
